w10_T4_002068: Bo's route around the park is 152 steps long, and every morning he walks it 3 times. He did that on each of the 7 mornings last week, and on the last morning he also walked 30 extra steps to the shop for milk. His neighbour Cy, who is recovering from a knee operation, walked exactly half as many steps as Bo did over the whole week, so Bo was well ahead of Cy. How many steps did Cy walk last week?
w10_T4_002071: Dee's doctor told her to drink 9 glasses of water a day, and each of her glasses holds 240 millilitres. She also drinks 36 millilitres of water with her morning vitamins and 26 millilitres when she takes her evening tablet. That daily total is more than her flatmate Eli drinks in a day, and Eli owns a dozen water bottles. Dee kept exactly to this routine for all 7 days of last week. How many millilitres of water did Dee drink last week?
w10_T4_002074: Fay is paid 121 cents for every hour she works at the cafe, plus a 34-cent hourly bonus for the early shift. She works 8 hours a day, and every day she spends 580 cents of that day's pay on lunch. She worked 4 days this week. Fay tracks her pay in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents did Fay keep from this week's pay after her lunches?
w10_T4_002078: Gus started a round of the arcade game with 114 points. He lost 79 points in the first level, 22 points in the second, and 5 points in the third. The game has 20 levels in total. In the bonus level every point Gus still had became worth 6 points, and then a treasure chest added 30 points. How many points did Gus have at the end of the round?
w10_T4_002086: In the morning 3 vans delivered chairs to the conference centre, with 210 chairs in each van, and the crew set them all out in the first hall. In the afternoon 13 chairs were brought up from the basement and 17 chairs were borrowed from the cafe, all added to the first hall, and the crew then set out the 4 halls in the building with exactly the same number of chairs in each. The conference centre is 25 years old. In the evening, after the day's sessions, the crew stacked away half of all the chairs. How many chairs were still set out in the evening?
w10_T4_002095: Hal gets pocket money every day. His allowance was 82 cents a day, and his parents raised it by 6 cents a day for good grades. After he broke a window, they took 75 cents off the daily amount to pay for it. When he started walking the dog they added 58 cents a day, and when he began helping with the dishes they added 17 cents a day more. He received that final daily amount on each of the 6 days of the school trip week and spent 38 cents of it on a postcard. Hal counts in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents does Hal have left from that week's pocket money?
w10_T4_002105: Ida's team collected 215 cans for the recycling drive, and the other 2 teams collected exactly the same amount, so 3 teams' worth of cans went into the pile, triple what Ida's team alone had gathered. The pile was then shared equally among the 3 schools taking part, and Ida's school took its share. Her school divided its cans equally among its 5 classes, and Ida's class received its share. Ida's class then gave 6 cans to the art room, sent 29 cans to the recycling plant, and found 9 more cans behind the bike shed. How many cans does Ida's class have now?
w10_T4_002108: On Saturday morning Jan had 84 dollars in her purse and spent half of it on a concert ticket. In the afternoon her aunt topped up Jan's purse until it held 3 times as much as it had after buying the ticket, and then Jan found 6 dollars in an old coat pocket and was given 6 dollars by her brother. The concert venue is 40 kilometres away. In the evening Jan spent half of everything in her purse on dinner. How many dollars are in Jan's purse now?
w10_T4_002110: On Saturday morning Kay's bakery baked 4 trays of rolls with 188 rolls on each tray, and then 10 more rolls in a small tin. In the afternoon, Lou's much larger bakery on the same street had 7 times as many rolls as Kay's had that morning, and Lou then baked 23 more, so Lou had far more rolls than Kay. In the evening Lou sold 2123 rolls to a hotel, which serves a dozen kinds of bread at breakfast. How many rolls does Lou have left?
w10_T4_002113: Mo had 86 dollars in her savings account. She deposited 11 dollars from her paper round, then withdrew 73 dollars for a new coat, and later deposited 10 dollars from a birthday card. The bank's young saver bonus then made her balance 3 times what it had been. She deposited 17 dollars from babysitting and 6 dollars from returning bottles. How many dollars are in Mo's account now?
w10_T4_002114: A gardener planted 135 tulip bulbs, sharing them equally among 5 flower beds. In the front bed every bulb produced 9 flowers over the spring. The gardener also added 18 daffodils and 41 hyacinths to the front bed, which lies beside a dozen apple trees. She then cut 204 flowers from the front bed for bouquets. How many flowers are left in the front bed?
w10_T4_002134: Nia earns 236 dollars a day as a set builder and worked all 7 days last week. Her assistant Ole earned exactly half as much as Nia did last week, so Nia took home more than Ole. Nia is 34 years old. Ole then worked 4 more weeks at that same weekly pay. He spent 208 dollars on a new drill and received a 61-dollar tip from a client. How many dollars did Ole keep from those 4 weeks after the drill and the tip?
w10_T4_002138: In the morning Pia's phone showed 227 minutes of talk time left on her plan. She made a 34-minute call to her mother and a 44-minute call to a client before lunch. In the afternoon she spent 52 minutes on a call with her landlord and 74 minutes on a call with her sister, who has a dozen cats. In the evening she made a 7-minute call to order a pizza. The plan shows the balance in minutes rather than hours, and sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of talk time does Pia have left?
w10_T4_002145: Quin the plumber charges 70 dollars to visit a house plus 66 dollars for the first hour of work, and every one of the 6 jobs he did this week took exactly one hour. His van is 5 years old, and he has been a plumber for a dozen years. One customer gave him a 40-dollar tip. At the end of the week he spent 770 dollars on new tools. How many dollars does Quin have left from this week's work?
w10_T4_002147: The Lyric theatre has 171 seats, but 27 of them are blocked off for the lighting rig during the festival. The theatre runs 6 shows a day, and on top of the seats it sells 21 standing tickets each day. A ticket costs 30 dollars. The festival lasts 5 days, and every seat and standing ticket was sold for every show, which pleased the theatre's dozen volunteers. How many tickets were sold during the festival?
w10_T4_002148: Rex dug up 235 kilograms of potatoes from his main plot and 8 kilograms from the corner plot. Sal's farm, which covers 40 hectares, produced 6 times as many kilograms as Rex did in that harvest, so Sal's crop dwarfed Rex's. Sal also picked up 65 kilograms that the harvester had missed. Sal brought in 6 harvests like that over the season, and half of everything she harvested went to a wholesaler. How many kilograms did the wholesaler take?
w10_T4_002163: Tam cycles 30 minutes to work, 34 minutes back home by the scenic route, and 49 minutes around the park in the evening on each of his cycling days. His bike cost 400 dollars, and he has owned it for a dozen years. He cycles 3 days every week and kept that up for 8 weeks. Tam logs his riding in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes did Tam cycle over those 8 weeks?
w10_T4_002166: Uma had 121 dollars in her purse at the start of the trip. She paid 17 dollars for a bus ticket, received 22 dollars from a friend who owed her money, paid 59 dollars for a hostel bed, spent 60 dollars on a museum pass, and bought a 4-dollar postcard. When she got home, her mother matched whatever was left in the purse, giving Uma 2 times what she had. Uma keeps her accounts in dollars rather than cents, since one hundred cents make a dollar. How many dollars does Uma have now?
w10_T4_002167: The scout troop collected 4 sacks of cans for the deposit scheme, with 115 cans in each sack. Half of the cans turned out to be the wrong type and were sent to ordinary recycling, and the troop then gave 73 of the good cans to a rival troop that was short. The troop took the rest to the deposit machine, which paid 5 cents for every can. A passer-by then donated 59 cents to the troop's tin, and a shopkeeper added 67 cents. How many cents did the troop have in its tin?
w10_T4_002174: A biscuit recipe uses 40 grams of butter for each batch, and the baker makes 3 batches of dough at a time and then divides the dough equally among 3 baking tins. Each tin of biscuits fills 1 box, 4 boxes go into a carton, 8 cartons go into a crate, and the bakery shipped 8 crates last week. Of the butter in that shipment, 625 grams' worth of biscuits were damaged in transit and thrown away. The bakery records butter in grams rather than kilograms, and one thousand grams make a kilogram. How many grams of butter were in the biscuits that arrived undamaged?
w10_T4_002176: Wu earns 77 cents for every newspaper he delivers, and he delivers 7 papers each morning. Every morning he pays 45 cents for the bus to the depot. He worked 9 mornings in a row and then shared the money equally among himself and his 2 brothers. Wu has already done 4 stretches of 9 mornings like that, sharing the money the same way every time, and saved his own share each time. He counts in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents has Wu saved from those 4 stretches?
w10_T4_002179: A vineyard is planted with 214 vines in every row, 8 rows in every block, and 9 blocks across the estate. The owner, who has run the vineyard for a dozen years, also planted 30 vines along the driveway, 61 vines around the house, and 7 vines by the gate. How many vines are there on the estate?
w10_T4_002181: In the morning Yan tested a drip emitter in his greenhouse and found it released 61 millilitres of water every minute, and each row of plants has 5 emitters. In the afternoon he switched on both of the 2 rows and let them run for 9 minutes. In the evening he set the timer so that this same 9-minute watering would happen 4 times a day from then on. Yan measures water in millilitres rather than litres, since one thousand millilitres make a litre. How many millilitres of water will the greenhouse receive in one full day under the new timer?
w10_T4_002184: Zed had 90 loyalty stamps on his cafe card and used 88 of them to pay for a birthday cake. The cafe is 6 blocks from his flat. On points day, each stamp left on the card was converted into 5 points, and because it was a promotion day the cafe then made his points total 2 times as large. He then bought a coffee that earned him 73 points. How many points does Zed have now?
w10_T4_002191: Ana's allotment plot gave her 210 kilograms of vegetables last season, plus 20 kilograms of herbs. Her friend Bo's plot is far more productive: it gives 4 times as much as Ana's whole plot did in a season. Bo has 4 plots that each produce that amount, and each of them gives 4 harvests a year. How many kilograms do Bo's plots produce in a year?
